prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished original calligraphic LOGO CONCEPT SHEET for the opening of a mature classic PC strategy game about running a coastal steel-coil company. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Completely flat uniform deep navy background #0b1b24, warm ivory ink #e9e1cc only. Two separate finished typographic logos stacked vertically with generous clean negative space; upper logo centered in upper half, lower logo centered in lower half. No dividing line, no boxed panels. Upper logo must read exactly "Production Gonsama" (Gonsama spelled G-o-n-s-a-m-a); lower logo must read exactly "Ethan.J Studio" (Ethan dot J, E-t-h-a-n-.-J). Smaller supporting words "Production" and "Studio" may be positioned on their own line, but both full names must be complete and readable. Make "Gonsama" and "Ethan.J" the strongest elements. This is a genuine custom hand-lettered wordmark, not a typed generic font. Legible large letters with strong silhouette at opening-screen scale. No extra words, no labels, no symbols/icons/emblems, no crowns, no redseal, no ornaments. No goldchrome, no gradients, no glow, no shadows, no 3D, no blur, no pixelation or downsampling, no fake old-paper backdrop. Refined yet warm and human; evocative of an old game's handcrafted publisher credit, not a wedding invitation or luxury hotel. Direction A: energetic bold dry-brush calligraphy in Latin cursive. Broad brush pressure with strong thick-to-thin strokes, natural slightly ragged ink edges and only a little visible bristle texture. Calm mostly level baseline, moderately connected letters; letters must remain distinct. Compact, confident, dignified, a craftsperson's signature. No long underline/swash crossing the letters, no excessive loops. Production and Studio also hand-brushed but quieter and very readable.
